compliance_units.constraint: is responsible to perform a security review

compliance_units.conditions: in consultation with the Developer and System Administrator
compliance_units.subject: the Security Officer / Consultant
compliance_units.context: security controls as part of systems design
compliance_units.constraint: is responsible to document security controls that must be put in place as part of systems design

compliance_units.conditions: before the system can proceed for implementation
compliance_units.subject: the steering committee
compliance_units.context: an updated TRA (Threat and Risk Assessment) including updated risk, assessments and recommendations
compliance_units.constraint: must approve an updated TRA, including updated risk, assessments and recommendations

compliance_units.conditions: prior to performing application testing; after every source code review
compliance_units.subject: the Project Manager
compliance_units.context: vendor's application source code for projects which they do not own the source codes
compliance_units.constraint: has to put in place a mitigation plan to address all vulnerabilities found after every source code review, and conduct a follow-up review to validate the effectiveness of the mitigation actions, which needs to be approved or risk accepted

compliance_units.conditions: prior to performing systems acceptance testing
compliance_units.subject: Developer
compliance_units.context: application/unit testing of systems and their modules in the development lifecycle
compliance_units.constraint: must perform application testing to isolate and validate that individual modules are correct and fit for use, and a mitigation plan must be put in place to address all vulnerabilities found followed by a regression test to validate the effectiveness of the mitigation actions, which must be approved or risk accepted

compliance_units.conditions: prior to the completion of the Systems Security Acceptance Testing
compliance_units.subject: the Steering Committee
compliance_units.context: Systems Security Acceptance Testing
compliance_units.constraint: must accept or mitigate all test results

compliance_units.subject: The Project Manager
compliance_units.context: Penetration Testing of the system under development, performed by an independent Security Officer / Consultant (third-party assessor) to find vulnerabilities an attacker could exploit
compliance_units.constraint: is responsible to ensure that Penetration Testing is performed adequately, a mitigation plan is put in place to address all vulnerabilities, and all follow-up tests are conducted

compliance_units.conditions: results must be reported and approved prior to the commissioning of the system; documentation must be handed over and accepted prior to entering the Operations/Maintenance phase
compliance_units.context: the system being commissioned and its project documentation from current and previous SBD phases
compliance_units.constraint: System Security Acceptance Testing and Penetration Testing must be performed, and their results including mitigation actions should be reported to the Steering Committee and approved; all project documentation (outputs from current and previous SBD phases) must be handed over and accepted by the operations team

compliance_units.conditions: after all system and application changes
compliance_units.subject: The Security Officer / Consultant, who should be an independent third party assessor
compliance_units.context: system and application changes (system and environmental changes)
compliance_units.constraint: should perform the Security Review at appropriate intervals to ensure that security controls in place continue to be effective

compliance_units.context: a system's security posture
compliance_units.constraint: Perform Change Management to identify significant changes and impact that alter a system's security posture

compliance_units.subject: the Developer
compliance_units.context: configuration management of the system
compliance_units.constraint: is responsible to initiate the configuration management and consult the Security Officer / Consultant on potential impact to the security of the system

compliance_units.conditions: using continuous monitoring results and decisions
compliance_units.subject: System Owners
compliance_units.context: systems
compliance_units.constraint: continually prioritise security risk and update/implement the necessary security controls needed to keep systems secured

compliance_units.conditions: reassessment triggered by user feedback, technology changes, policy changes, new threats and vulnerabilities, and other business-related issues
compliance_units.subject: System Owners
compliance_units.context: the system while in use/operation during the reassessment control gate phase
compliance_units.constraint: act as the approving authority for the control gate and validate that security reviews confirm built-in controls remain effective (reporting results to the steering committee), validate security assessment and review reports address system and environmental changes, and regularly review TRA reports and the risk register to ensure risks remain valid and are continually addressed

compliance_units.conditions: taking into consideration the obsolescence or unavailability of the archival technology in the future and legal and regulatory obligations for minimum records retention periods
compliance_units.subject: Project Manager
compliance_units.context: archived information and the archival method
compliance_units.constraint: should select an archival method that facilitates future information retrieval, and should mark and handle the archived information in compliance with its security classification

compliance_units.conditions: based on the security classification of the system and its information
compliance_units.subject: the System Owners
compliance_units.context: the system's digital media
compliance_units.constraint: shall sanitise the system's digital media using approved equipment, techniques and procedures according to relevant policies and regulations

compliance_units.conditions: depending on relevant policies and regulation; disposal of software should comply with licence agreements
compliance_units.subject: System Administrator
compliance_units.context: hardware (which can be sold, discarded or given away) and software
compliance_units.constraint: is responsible for disposing the hardware according to the disposal plan and updating the disposition

compliance_units.subject: the System Owners
compliance_units.context: the disposal phase control gate of a system, covering system information, media, and hardware/software
compliance_units.constraint: shall act as the approving authority for the disposal-phase control gate, ensuring the system is terminated in an orderly manner, vital system information is preserved per applicable records management regulations and policies for future access, all media is accorded the correct sanitisation method, and hardware and software are disposed according to policy

compliance_units.subject: System owners
compliance_units.context: threat modelling for cybersecurity risk assessment of Critical Information Infrastructure
compliance_units.constraint: should cultivate a customised threat perspective that goes beyond meeting minimum generic standards, adopting the suggested threat modelling framework to derive a robust system threat model and relevant threat events and incorporate these into their cybersecurity risk assessment

compliance_units.conditions: guidance is for individuals or groups who would like to build a threat model for their systems; excludes cyber threat intelligence monitoring and studying geo-political threats, which are beyond the scope of this document
compliance_units.subject: Users
compliance_units.context: a threat model for their system(s), focusing on technical scoping, system decomposition, threat identification and attack modelling
compliance_units.constraint: may use the results of the threat model as inputs to other assessments, such as cybersecurity risk assessments, to prioritise risk controls

compliance_units.conditions: based on context of the business needs, greater enterprise environment, situation and audience
compliance_units.subject: the User
compliance_units.context: threat analysis approach (management, system, or equipment/application level)
compliance_units.constraint: must choose the threat modelling approach based on context

compliance_units.conditions: especially whenever there are material changes to the system

compliance_units.context: threat modelling of their systems
compliance_units.constraint: should adopt good practices and avoid common missteps when conducting threat modelling, including considering all subsequent stages of an attack, maintaining balanced threat focus with well-defined scope, and refreshing the threat model constantly rather than taking a 'once and done' approach

compliance_units.conditions: since risk assessment is a continuous cycle

compliance_units.context: the cybersecurity risk assessment process for Critical Information Infrastructure
